replacements.before:
- name: Verify final tracked-tree hygiene
        run: node --test scripts/tests/m3-repository-hygiene.test.mjs
replacements.after:
- name: Verify final tracked-tree hygiene
        shell: bash
        run: |
          m3_status=0
          node --test scripts/tests/m3-repository-hygiene.test.mjs \
            >m3-repository-hygiene.log 2>&1 || m3_status=$?
          cat m3-repository-hygiene.log
          exit "$m3_status"

logEvidenceScope.source: Existing M3 CI TAP, fixture diagnostics and bounded native PostgreSQL fixture receipt
logEvidenceScope.purpose: Retain independently readable M3 test identities without fetching the entire large hygiene job log
logEvidenceScope.limitations: Raw file capture does not establish console-mask equivalence or sanitize arbitrary failure diagnostics
